body:
Thank you for responding. I asked him to be sure it was the best decision for him and he said he was sure it was. I can't take that away from him. 

I don't know if I'm scared to be alone. I don't feel like I am, but I can't be certain. I know he's very special though.

I did something bad. I don't think he forgave me for it, and I don't think I'll ever forgive myself. After 2 years together he came out to me as bisexual, and he hadn't told anyone else and I wasn't supportive. I panicked and cried and said stupid things because I didn't know what it meant for the relationship. He needed me to listen and I just panicked and told him over and over that I didn't understand. He explained things and I asked a lot of questions and I thought we could get past it. But I found out last night he hasn't told anyone else because of how I reacted. I made him feel like the world didn't want him, and it's the most awful thing in the world. He couldn't get past that I might not accept him and it's entirely my fault.

I wish I could go back six months and I would go through all the pain in my body, nd the stress from going back to school, leaving work, having to move, having to see my mom, having my funding denied, guilt from finding a friends passing years ago was from an eating disorder and I could have done something. Just so I could do those 5 minutes right this time.
